answer: Split-tally stops bulk fakes. An agent files one marble in a tally bound by an anchor to its key, locking 60 credits. Two keepers split it, publishing crystal receipts. Halves reconcile; a mismatch burns the bond. The first pays 18, the k-th 18+3(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 1,516,500, lock 60,000, against a 40,000 pool. A borrowed marble fails: rented tallies carry the lender's anchor and never reconcile. Honest agents pay 18 once, keeping their share.
